visual_review.result: All complete source pages inspected; protocol table/footnotes verified against extracted text.

document_role: Manufacturer instructions, not an animal-specific assay run log.

direct_manual_support.value: MDA reacts with thiobarbituric acid to form a red product; absorbance maximum 532 nm.
a typically 0.1–0.2 mL; sample, standard, ethanol blank, and reagent1 aliquot volumes are equal.
95°C water bath 40 min, cooling under running water, then 3500–4000 rpm centrifugation 10 min; collect supernatant for absorbance.
Post-reaction precipitate clarification; not initial separation of serum from blood.
532 nm; 1 cm path applies to cuvette reading; page5 also describes 200 μL microplate-reader measurements.
Dedicated sample-control tube can be omitted/replaced by blank for samples without hemolysis/lipemia; normal versus simplified methods differ in wording. Do not infer which was used in this study.
If absorbance is too low, 40 min may be extended to 80 min, consistently across that study. This is an optional branch, not evidence it was executed.
Reference example: 5% or 10% homogenates, 0.1–0.2 mL. These examples do not establish the current RVLM homogenization buffer, mass, dilution, or volume.

method_update_decisions.decision: Retain actual530nm. Do not silently replace with532nm or claim equal signal/sensitivity was independently validated.
Can describe manufacturer recommended protocol with explicit attribution. State as actual execution only if assay run record or author confirms it was followed.
Do not use post-TBA centrifugation parameters as blood-to-serum processing parameters.

Formula is supported by actual workbook/current analysis, with supplied standard concentration and equal sample/standard volume corroborated by manual. Do not cite the manual as containing that exact printed formula. Protein concentration must correspond to assayed homogenate; any separate dilution factor must come from actual preparation record.
Keep existingn6/current processed values and statistical results; no recalculation or reassignment required by merely supplying this manual.

formula_dimensional_check: (dimensionless absorbance ratio × nmol/mL) ÷ (mg protein/mL) = nmol/mg protein; equal standard/sample aliquots cancel aliquot volume. This does not itself verify assay specificity or missing sample preparation parameters.
not_established: Current cohort animal/sample IDs, n, timepoints, initial serum centrifugation conditions, actual sample aliquot, homogenization dilution, actual 40min versus80min branch, actual blank versus paired-control implementation.
proposed_safe_wording_chinese: MDA采用硫代巴比妥酸（TBA）比色法检测（A003-1，南京建成生物工程研究所）。根据保留的检测记录，在530nm读取吸光度；试剂盒说明书列出的推荐波长为532nm。以10nmol/mL标准品进行换算，并按照同一样本的蛋白浓度归一化，结果以nmol/mg蛋白表示。
wording_caution: Use proposed wording only alongside the actual assay record supporting530nm and workbook supporting the stated blank correction; do not transform optional manufacturer steps into confirmed execution.
